description: This file contains test cases for various functions related to context window management and configuration in a machine learning/AI agent context, written using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: applyDiscoveredContextWindows
methods.description: Adjusts cache entries for models based on discovered context windows, preferring the smallest context window for models with the same ID.

methods.name: applyConfiguredContextWindows
methods.description: Updates cache entries based on configured context windows and models configuration, handling provider-specific settings.

methods.name: createSessionManagerRuntimeRegistry
methods.description: Creates a registry for session-specific objects keyed by object identity, allowing storing, reading, and clearing values.

methods.name: resolveContextTokensForModel
methods.description: Determines the number of context tokens to use for a given model, considering configuration flags and fallback values.
